message.content: The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **23,000–24,000 total casualties**—including killed, wounded, and missing—for both sides combined. Estimates vary slightly depending on the source, but most historians agree on this figure as the overall toll of the engagement.
